nvitk.measure.volume
====================

.. py:module:: nvitk.measure.volume

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Volume measurements on a binary/label mask.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.measure.volume.volume_mm3
   nvitk.measure.volume.volume_cc


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: volume_mm3(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   Return the number of non-zero voxels in *mask* × voxel volume (mm^3).


.. py:function:: volume_cc(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None = None) -> float

   Return the mask's volume in cubic centimetres (mL).
